initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game-building sprite for VarCamp WorkAdventure. Input image 1 is the visual/style reference (detailed charcoal-and-copper Aries pavilion); image 2 is a geometric reference only, an atlas of small gates, of which only the upper two are relevant. Make ONE new full pavilion facade, not an atlas. It is seen from the same overhead-front RPG angle as image1, crisply outlined, readable at native256x192 pixels, landscape4:3 composition. Its overall silhouette must fit a box8tiles wide by6tiles tall. Two substantial side wings/pillars each take the outer quarter of the width; a continuous magnificent shallow roof occupies the top half. The centered public entrance is a VERY WIDE OPEN ARCHWAY: the middle50percent of the width must be completely transparent from the vertical midpoint all the way to the bottom. This is an open passage, not glass doors, no interior scene, no floor covering the passage. The side wings can reach the bottom. Keep the ENTIRE subject visible with transparent margin on all sides. Genuine transparent background. Existing game will add a small nameplate across the roof immediately above the open entrance, so no rendered text. High quality readable architectural details, crisp dark outlines, discrete highlights that downsample well; no surrounding ground or scenery, no people, no logos, no letters, no watermark. Subject: SOLAR HALL. A welcoming radiant sun pavilion, gold and warm copper over charcoal masonry, warm amber glass in the two side wings. Make the roof itself a broad dramatic SUNBURST with a round golden solar disk in the top center and bold short radial triangular rays extending across the roof silhouette, flanked by low gold stepped wings. The sun disk and roof rays must be the dominant immediately recognizable architectural feature, all in the top half. Small warm lamps and geometric copper inlays on the outer piers. Modern fantasy conference hall, VarCamp warmth, substantial architecture rather than a sign stuck on a plain gate.
